description: This file contains test cases for parsing CLI output JSON and JSONL data, focusing on functions parseCliJson and parseCliJsonl. It tests how these functions handle embedded metadata, response texts, and token usage information across different command scenarios.

methods.name: parseCliJson
methods.description: Parses JSON output from CLI commands, extracting response text, session id, and usage information.

methods.name: parseCliJsonl
methods.description: Parses JSONL (newline-delimited JSON) stream output from CLI commands, extracting response text, session id, and usage information.
